title: croton scaber var. genuinus
intro: Croton scaber var. genuinus, commonly known as the "Genuine Croton," is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a shrub-like plant native to the Philippines and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Croton scaber var. genuinus include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and antiseptic activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
